scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), { execSync } = require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend')) { execSync('cd frontend && npx vite build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { execSync('npx vite build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
